description: Downloads an Hourly Snapshot TSV_GZIP feed file containing details of all items that have changed within the specified day and hour for a specific category. Files are available with a 2-hour latency.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: The formats that the client accepts for the response.

parameters.name: X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID
parameters.description: The ID of the eBay marketplace where the item is hosted.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Range in bytes for chunked download. Maximum 100 MB.

parameters.name: snapshot_date
parameters.description: The date and hour of the snapshot (UTC yyyy-MM-ddThh:00:00.000Z).
